Maya (Growth): quick flag  Weekly KPI shows launch-post CTR steady but paid MQLs dipped ~20% MoM. dropping into this thread to triage. :eyes:
Owen (Analytics): seeing it. paid sessions up but conversions down; bounce spike at ~10:42 PT for clicks coming via redirector.adpartner.io
Riya (MarOps): did we rotate any tracking rules? I updated campaign canonicalization last week but only for email channels.
Casey (ProdM): only organic headline test ran yesterday. paid creative unchanged per creative-registry.
Owen (Analytics): ran a quick jaw-drop SQL to check campaign churn:
```
SELECT coalesce(utm_campaign,'(missing)') campaign, count(*) convs
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY convs DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
Owen (Analytics): results show a new (missing) bucket tied to referer host adproxy-v2.adpartner.io  probably stripping query params on some click paths.
Riya (MarOps): that matches a support thread with AdPartner (AP-997). They're trialing a redirect shim. I'll escalate.
Maya (Growth): for Friday KPI send we need numbers that won't undercount paid. Can we add a soft fallback in BI that infers campaign from referer or last-touch session?
Owen (Analytics): yes  I'll add a heuristic_campaign field in ETL: utm_campaign -> previous-session campaign -> referer host mapping. low-risk. ETA ~35m to BI.
deploy-bot: dashboard "launch_metrics_weekly" updated by Owen. https://bi.redwood/d/launch_metrics_weekly
Maya (Growth): great. once landed re-run the WoW and I'll update the KPI email copy to note attribution cleanup.
Riya (MarOps): will update AP-997 thread and add hidden_campaign_token to the registration backlog so server-side capture avoids future client-side loss.
Casey (ProdM): agree on hidden token. also let's record a runbook for quick attribution fallbacks in the dashboard for future launch pushes.
Maya (Growth): owners: Riya -> vendor escalation + backlog; Owen -> ETL heuristic + dashboard patch; Casey -> runbook; Maya -> re-run & KPI email. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Owen (Analytics): posting interim numbers when ETL completes.
